practice_units.title: Identifying Major Dynasties
practice_units.problem: Match the following dynasties with their primary regions: Rashtrakutas, Palas, Gurjara-Pratiharas.
guidance: Rashtrakutas were based in the Deccan.
Palas ruled mainly in the Bengal region.
Gurjara-Pratiharas were dominant in Western India and parts of the North.
practice_units.solution: Rashtrakutas - Deccan; Palas - Bengal; Gurjara-Pratiharas - Western India.

practice_units.title: The Tripartite Struggle
practice_units.problem: Explain why Kanauj was the center of conflict between three major dynasties.
guidance: Understand that Kanauj was a symbol of prestige and power in the Gangetic valley.
Note the fertility and economic value of the region.
Identify the three parties: Palas, Pratiharas, and Rashtrakutas.
practice_units.solution: The 'Tripartite Struggle' for Kanauj occurred because each dynasty wanted control over the fertile and strategically important Ganga valley to establish their supremacy.
